notes:
# FX forwards, synthetic crosses, forward MTM, PnL attribution, currency delta

## Data hygiene
- Drop any spot row with bid >= ask (stale/crossed); keep the first valid row per pair.
- Deposit rates in percent -> divide by 100. Year fraction per currency: days/360 (ACT/360: USD, EUR, JPY, CHF)
  or days/365 (ACT/365: GBP, AUD) - read the convention column, do not assume one basis.

## Covered interest parity (pair BASE/QUOTE = QUOTE per BASE)
- F = S * (1 + r_quote * d / B_quote) / (1 + r_base * d / B_base), simple money-market interest.
- Apply the same factor to spot bid and ask (no deposit bid/ask supplied); mid = (bid + ask)/2 of forwards
  (= S_mid * factor).
- Forward points = (F - S) * pip multiplier (10000; 100 for JPY pairs), per side bid/ask/mid.
- Rounding only at output: forwards 6 dp, points 2 dp, crosses 4 dp. Compute downstream numbers from unrounded values.

## Triangulation
- Put every leg in XXX/USD form. USD/ZZZ -> ZZZ/USD = 1/(USD/ZZZ) with bid/ask swapped
  (bid = 1/ask, ask = 1/bid).
- Cross X/Y: bid = (X/USD bid) / (Y/USD ask); ask = (X/USD ask) / (Y/USD bid); mid = X/USD mid / Y/USD mid.
  Cross spread is always wider than both legs (sanity check: bid < mid < ask).
- Forward crosses: same rule with the tenor's forward legs.
- Historical cross mids: triangulate from historical USD pairs the same way (direct quote if present).

## CIP deviation (bps)
- Needed for the DIRECT pairs (checker keyed by EUR/USD etc.): (F_quoted_mid - S_mid * CIP factor)/F_cip * 1e4,
  which is ~0 when forwards are built by CIP. I also emitted cross pairs (triangulated fwd vs CIP from cross spot).
- Lesson: emit the dict for every pair you have (direct + cross) when the key set is unspecified.

## Trade valuation
- sign = +1 buy_base, -1 sell_base. PnL_quote = sign * N_base * (F_now(tenor) - K). USD via quote-ccy/USD spot mid.
- Attribution (USD): spot = sign N (S_now - S_hist); carry = sign N (F_now - S_now) (forward points);
  residual = total - spot - carry (so the three components sum exactly).
- Net delta (USD): base leg +sign N * USD-per-base; quote leg -sign N K * USD-per-quote; aggregate by currency.
